name: normal_two_sample_d20
description: Two-sample pooled z test, equal allocation, d=0.2 (small effect), alpha=0.05 two-sided, 80% power. Allocation contract: n1=round(n0); the minimal control size is n0=393 (n1=393, total 786). n0=392 (392+392=784) gives 0.79956 and fails.

reference.provenance: Direct scipy.stats.norm evaluation with n1 derived from n0, independently of ssp.kernels
